settings.probe: one original-noise query at the original fork, zero executed steps and no RNG/history commit
settings.switch: once at entry: exactly F -> withdraw4; otherwise A -> smooth2; P -> alternating side; I/C -> replan2; none -> resample
settings.random_switch: uniform over the same six possible switch outputs, independent of policy noise
settings.stopping: success or original total 520 steps; physical phases and eight transformed queries are bounded
settings.evaluation: 100 fresh original Long initializations 15..24; all usable first v8.2 alarms
settings.stability_scope: nominal Cartesian integrator only; MoE scores are observations, not certified Lyapunov or barrier functions

outcome_models.selection: MoE prefix and elapsed steps only; no task ID, object pose, outcome, or future frames
outcome_models.training: all previous 150 mains and paired fixed-operator outcomes; task-isolated cross-validation
outcome_models.reference_weight: each main has total weight one; no chunk-wise train/test split
outcome_models.projection: weighted standardized covariance PCA; eight whitened coordinates
outcome_models.shuffle: deterministic derangement of pre-treatment choices, exact operator counts per repeat
outcome_models.missing: zero-filled normalized components with five explicit validity indicators
